answer.rationale: Finance’s 18% cost-reduction mandate cannot be met with the incumbent as they refuse to reopen pricing this cycle. The low-cost vendor’s quote alone satisfies the mandate, and memory_c2 confirms their reliable onboarding and accurate invoicing from a prior successful switch. With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% capacity with no buffer, immediate broad rollout to the low-cost vendor is the sole action that meets the cost objective without delay. The move increases near-term delivery risk (hence downstream_value_risk_flagged=true), but memory_c2’s positive precedent offsets this. Renegotiation (memory_c4) is blocked, renewal (memory_c1) fails the cost test, and deferral (memory_c5) would miss the mandate.
